description: This PHP source file defines the Smarty_Security class, which manages security settings and checks for the Smarty template engine. It includes methods to verify trusted functions, classes, tags, variables, streams, and resource directories, as well as security enforcement mechanisms.

classes.name: Smarty_Security
classes.description: Class that handles security configurations and validation for Smarty templates, including trusted functions, classes, tags, constants, streams, and resource directories.

methods.name: isTrustedPhpFunction
methods.description: Checks if a PHP function is trusted according to security settings.

methods.name: isTrustedStaticClass
methods.description: Verifies if a static class is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedStaticClassAccess
methods.description: Checks if access to a static class method or property is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedPhpModifier
methods.description: Checks if a PHP modifier plugin is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedTag
methods.description: Verifies if a template tag is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedSpecialSmartyVar
methods.description: Checks if a special $smarty variable is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedModifier
methods.description: Verifies if a modifier plugin is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedConstant
methods.description: Checks if a constant is trusted or permitted.

methods.name: isTrustedStream
methods.description: Verifies if a stream wrapper is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedResourceDir
methods.description: Checks if the directory of a file resource is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedUri
methods.description: Verifies if a URI is trusted based on security patterns.

methods.name: isTrustedPHPDir
methods.description: Checks if a PHP directory is trusted.

methods.name: _updateResourceDir
methods.description: Updates cache for resource directories, removing outdated entries and adding new directories.

methods.name: _checkDir
methods.description: Checks if a file path is inside a trusted directory and returns associated directories or throws exception.

methods.name: enableSecurity
methods.description: Enables security policies for a Smarty instance by setting a security class or object.

methods.name: startTemplate
methods.description: Starts template processing, checks for maximum nesting level.

methods.name: endTemplate
methods.description: Ends template processing, decreases nesting count.

methods.name: registerCallBacks
methods.description: Registers start/end callbacks for template rendering.
